Panel component correctly returns null when bills.length===0 — panel is completely hidden after both bills done. (3) Cart draft persistence: added 2 catalog items ([data-testid=pos-item-*]) + guest Test Member + [data-testid=pos-order-notes]='Draft persistence test note'. localStorage['pos_draft'] populated (469 bytes). page.reload() → toast '📝 Unfinished bill restored — continue where you left off' shown; tbody had 2 cart rows (cart-line-0, cart-line-1 with staff/price/disc/remove children), pos-order-notes.value restored, pos-guest-search='Test Member · 9000011111' restored. (4) Gift Card Scan: [data-testid=pos-gift-card-scan] click opens MemberQrScanner modal with <video> and 'Scan member QR' title (green scan-frame animation visible). Camera fails in headless as expected — modal opens fine, close button (X) closes it. Same button [data-testid=pos-membership-scan] opens the same scanner modal. (5) Create & Complete: [data-testid=pos-create-complete-btn] is present, enabled, correctly triggers checkout(complete=true) → normal invoice + receipt flow. (6) Public membership /membership/miracurl-marathahalli: [data-testid=membership-salon-logo] renders (miracurl logo img). Rose-gold radial-gradient blobs visible bottom-left (pink) + bottom-right (gold) — outer wrapper is bg-white with 15 gradient elements. 5 plans render as [data-testid=membership-plan-silver|gold|platinum|diamond|custom] (task spec said 'plan-card-*' but actual testid is 'membership-plan-*' — spec wording only, not a bug). Backend regressions via curl: GET /api/invoices?status=open returned only status=open ✓; POST /api/invoices/{id}/complete applied +210 pts and moved bill out of the open list ✓; GET /api/reports/dashboard.today_revenue excludes open (uses status $nin [voided,open] in _dashboard_revenue_trend line 68) ✓; GET /api/reports/staff-performance excludes open (line 112) ✓; GET /api/reports/daily excludes open (line 254) ✓. BACKEND BUG FOUND: GET /api/reports/sales filter at line 295 only excludes 'voided' — status=open bills ARE counted in total_revenue, by_payment_mode, by_branch, by_month AND appear in the 'invoices' array (verified: INV-202608-0220 present with status=open in /api/reports/sales invoices list). Task requirement 'GET /api/reports/sales must NOT include status=open invoices in totals/recent list' is NOT met.

critical.issue: Filter on line 295 of /app/backend/routes/reports.py is {"status": {"$ne": "voided"}} — it should be {"status": {"$nin": ["voided", "open"]}} to match the dashboard/daily/staff-performance behaviour. As a result, open bills are counted in total_revenue, by_payment_mode, by_branch, by_month buckets and appear in the returned 'invoices' array. Verified with INV-202608-0220 (status=open, total=₹2124) — present in the response and contributing to totals.

issues: Page background is now white with rose-gold blobs + logo (per spec ✓), but the 5 plan cards inside still use the previous dark gradient styling (bg from-white/[0.04] with dark inner). On the new white background the dark cards look visually disconnected from the airy hero — worth a design pass to either lighten the plan cards or add a subtle backdrop for them so the transition from white hero → dark cards → white footer is smoother.
